target_customer: Mid-market and enterprise contact centers and home services sellers (remodeling, roofing, windows, HVAC), plus airlines such as Eurowings
problem: Missed calls, slow speed to lead and contact center capacity limits make customer service and appointment booking costly.
business_model: B2B SaaS and usage-based voice and text AI agents with CRM integrations

founders.name: Arkadiy Telegin
founders.background_notes: YC page: previously worked in autonomous robotics (self-driving, space tech, consumer); led software division of a German space-tech student organization

founders.name: Shraey Bhatia
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder in YC team section; no background given. YC page says the founders previously worked at Microsoft, BCG and IBM Research without assigning employers.

technical_complexity.rationale: Needed low latency voice, multilingual speech and CRM integrations on top of third party models; standard engineering with some hard realtime parts.

defensibility.rationale: Built on commodity speech and LLM components; integrations and white glove onboarding give modest lock in but many voice agent vendors exist.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or shutdown found in searches through late 2026.

market_need_then: Contact centers with 100+ human agents were automated by the company per its YC description; the company states about 90 percent customer satisfaction (self reported).

brand_strength.rationale: No coverage of the brand itself found; name is a generic AI suffix compound.

outcome_analysis: Leaping AI is active and raised a 4.7 million dollar seed in August 2025 after the Winter 2025 batch, riding the voice agent wave with named customers like Eurowings and Thompson Creek Window Company. No exit, shutdown or layoffs were found. The market is crowded, so durability depends on enterprise contracts and integrations rather than technology alone.
notes: Round amount and lead appear in several aggregator and news snippets (Dealroom, Menlo Times via search summary) and the YC page lists a Business Insider headline on the 4.7M raise dated 2025-08-20; seedtable returned 403. One tracker lists 5.2M total and another 500K pre-seed, unverified. Founding year 2023 from YC page; aggregators disagree. Competitor search returned only 2026 vendor comparison pages (Retell, Synthflow, Bland, Vapi), nothing dated near January 2025, so the list is empty.
